NASB.1: Now these were the sons of David who were born to him in Hebron: the firstborn [was] Amnon, by Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second [was] Daniel, by Abigail the Carmelitess;
NASB.2: the third [was] Absalom the son of Maacah, the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth [was] Adonijah the son of Haggith;
NASB.3: the fifth [was] Shephatiah, by Abital; the sixth [was] Ithream, by his wife Eglah.
NASB.4: Six were born to him in Hebron, and there he reigned seven years and six months. And in Jerusalem he reigned thirty-three years.
NASB.5: These were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan and Solomon, four, by Bath-shua the daughter of Ammiel;
NASB.9: All [these were] the sons of David, besides the sons of the concubines; and Tamar [was] their sister.
NASB.10: Now Solomon's son [was] Rehoboam, Abijah [was] his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
NASB.11: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
NASB.12: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
NASB.13: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
NASB.14: Amon his son, Josiah his son.
NASB.15: The sons of Josiah [were] Johanan the firstborn, and the second [was] Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.
NASB.16: The sons of Jehoiakim [were] Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.
NASB.17: The sons of Jeconiah, the prisoner, [were] Shealtiel his son,
NASB.18: and Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama and Nedabiah.
NASB.19: The sons of Pedaiah [were] Zerubbabel and Shimei. And the sons of Zerubbabel [were] Meshullam and Hananiah, and Shelomith [was] their sister;
NASB.20: and Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah and Jushab-hesed, five.
NASB.21: The sons of Hananiah [were] Pelatiah and Jeshaiah, the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shecaniah.
NASB.22: The descendants of Shecaniah [were] Shemaiah, and the sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah and Shaphat, six.
NASB.23: The sons of Neariah [were] Elioenai, Hizkiah and Azrikam, three.
NASB.24: The sons of Elioenai [were] Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah and Anani, seven.

NLT.1:
These are the sons of David who were born in Hebron: The oldest was Amnon, whose mother was Ahinoam from Jezreel.
The second was Daniel, whose mother was Abigail from Carmel.
NLT.2:
The third was Absalom, whose mother was Maacah, the daughter of Talmai, king of Geshur.
The fourth was Adonijah, whose mother was Haggith.
NLT.3:
The fifth was Shephatiah, whose mother was Abital.
The sixth was Ithream, whose mother was Eglah, David’s wife.
NLT.4: These six sons were born to David in Hebron, where he reigned seven and a half years. Then David reigned another thirty-three years in Jerusalem.
NLT.5: The sons born to David in Jerusalem included Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon. Their mother was Bathsheba, the daughter of Ammiel.
NLT.6: David also had nine other sons: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,
NLT.9: These were the sons of David, not including his sons born to his concubines. Their sister was named Tamar.
NLT.10: The descendants of Solomon were Rehoboam, Abijah, Asa, Jehoshaphat,
NLT.15: The sons of Josiah were Johanan (the oldest), Jehoiakim (the second), Zedekiah (the third), and Jehoahaz (the fourth).
NLT.16: The successors of Jehoiakim were his son Jehoiachin and his brother Zedekiah.
NLT.17: The sons of Jehoiachin, who was taken prisoner by the Babylonians, were Shealtiel,
NLT.18: Malkiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
NLT.19: The sons of Pedaiah were Zerubbabel and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel were Meshullam and Hananiah. (Their sister was Shelomith.)
NLT.20: His five other sons were Hashubah, Ohel, Berekiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab-hesed.
NLT.21: The sons of Hananiah were Pelatiah and Jeshaiah. Jeshaiah’s son was Rephaiah. Rephaiah’s son was Arnan. Arnan’s son was Obadiah. Obadiah’s son was Shecaniah.
NLT.22: The descendants of Shecaniah were Shemaiah and his sons, Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat — six in all.
NLT.23: The sons of Neariah were Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam — three in all.
NLT.24: The sons of Elioenai were Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani — seven in all.

MSG.3: fifth, Shephatiah born of Abital; sixth, Ithream born of his wife Eglah.

MSG.9: David's sons, plus Tamar their sister. There were other sons by his concubines.
MSG.10: In the next generation Solomon had Rehoboam, who had Abijah, who had Asa, who had Jehoshaphat,
MSG.11: who had Jehoram, who had Ahaziah, who had Joash,
MSG.12: who had Amaziah, who had Azariah, who had Jotham,

MSG.14: who had Amon, who had Josiah.

MSG.18: , Malkiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
